title: Sonic 3D Blast (Genesis) - Diamond Dust Zone Act 1
description:
The happy, then pensive, then happy again music from the icy fourth zone of Sonic 3D Blast. Good for upbeat levels, and probably snow and ice ones too.

Special thanks as usual to Hazel for making me combat my own laziness to fix silly little inaccuracies. I love you.
